title: Python JSON & Iterators
description: JSON is a syntax for storing and exchanging data. Python has a built-in package called 'json' which can be used to work with JSON data. You can parse JSON strings into dictionaries using 'json.loads()' and convert dictionaries into JSON strings using 'json.dumps()'.
example:
// Working with JSON
import json

# JSON string to Dictionary
x = '{ "name":"John", "age":30, "city":"New York"}'
y = json.loads(x)
print(y["age"])

# Dictionary to JSON string
z = json.dumps(y)
print(z)

challenges.title: Parse JSON
challenges.exercise: Import json and print 'json.loads' to confirm you know how to parse a JSON string.
